IRR.name: Intent Resolution Rate (Longitudinal)

IRR_observed.interpretation: Rate of verified downstream success among intents that have had full time to mature.

IRR_pending.interpretation: Intents actively progressing along the possibility path whose outcome window remains open.

IRR_closed.interpretation: Percentage of cohort intents whose outcome or epistemic closure is finalized.

IRR.statistical_reporting: Report proportion, numerator, denominator, and 95% Wilson score confidence interval.

VOR.name: Verified Outcome Rate (Longitudinal)
VOR.interpretation: Fraction of dispatched execution actions that achieve verified completion.
VOR.statistical_reporting: Report proportion, numerator, denominator, and 95% Wilson score confidence interval.

SDR.name: Search Displacement Rate
SDR.interpretation: Empirical reduction in manual navigation, scanning, and filtration steps.

QIC.name: Qualified Intent Coverage
QIC.threshold: high_intent defined as intent_commerciality >= 0.70 OR outcome_criticality == 'HIGH'
QIC.statistical_reporting: Report proportion and sample size N.

T_lead.name: Intent Lead Time
T_lead.null_policy: Strictly NULL if no objective mainstream validation timestamp exists.

False_Certainty_Rate.name: False-Certainty Rate
False_Certainty_Rate.audit_mechanism: ProofLedger provenance matching; missing evidence triggers immediate policy violation.
